subject: vt-dy
title: (R)VT.DY.------POST.
description: Diagram in WI-26, paired with v1-p310-1. (R)VT-DY — the reality of vibrational dynamics — is crossed with POST (postulation). This is structurally the *same crossing* as the CODE/v1-p14 example schematic from Braxton's pedagogical opening, returning here in the WI context. VT-DY → POST (the crossing). VT-DY also branches to SG (source initiation) → PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies), to RT-ALGN (reality alignment) → LANG-DY (language dynamics), and to AFTD (affinity tendencies), which branches to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and to INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) → AFI (affinity insight). The pedagogical example from p14 is here re-asked with explicit social-political stakes.
